binder_audit.k_n_bits: TYPING: natural carriers and dimensions. Public data width is n+1, not n; physical width is (n+1)+HermiteFiniteChain.bondQubits k.
binder_audit.L_and_hL: L:Real and hL:0<L retain the inherited SOURCE Hermite domain. No rational-input, bounded-L, conditioning or pivot-separation restriction is silently added.
binder_audit.epsilon_and_he: epsilon:Real and he:0<epsilon are SOURCE: the requested positive approximation tolerance. Positivity is a mathematical/source-domain restriction needed when dividing by epsilon, not mere typing. Zero/negative tolerances are outside compile_epsilon and compile_certified.
binder_audit.generic_helpers: Generic rounding accepts any typed ExactAngle and PrimitiveCircuit, including real angles, zero wires with an empty list and non-RY gates. column_error has only two matrices as inputs. Internal compileAt_basis uses the existing max-bond and in-range proof binders; they do not become new caller assumptions of public Hermite roots.
binder_audit.membership_root: compile_dyadic_basis additionally takes the actual gate g and hg:g in compile k n L hL bits. Membership is an ordinary input-elimination condition, not an assumed RY/CX or angle-accuracy certificate.
binder_audit.not_public_hypotheses: Alignment, canonicality, normalization, exact target action, unitary completion, primitive closure and polynomial gate count are constructed or proved through named dependencies. No free angle supplier or action callback is a public hypothesis.

actual_return_audit.compile: The definition let-binds exactly one StagedGlobalAssembly.compile k n L hL result and maps its run.value with roundCircuit. This is the actual source-returned chronological list, not a choose/existential witness or an alternate circuit selected from a norm bound. The let is source-level mathematical sharing, not an extracted-runtime caching certificate.
actual_return_audit.source_dependency: GlobalAssembly.compile itself let-binds one normalized canonical source, materializes every compileAt through collect, and uses actual closed lift/stage/output placement and persistent assembly. Its own exact-real cost counters are separate from the new map; DyadicSupplier.compile returns only a PrimitiveCircuit and does not extend those counters to floor or map work.
actual_return_audit.order_targets: roundCircuit is List.map. roundGate changes only RY angle fields; physical targets, CX control/target/distinctness and all chronological positions are retained. Generic X and RZ remain unchanged, so generic roundCircuit is not claimed to make arbitrary RZ angles dyadic.
actual_return_audit.primitive_closure: Read the actual realizeGate definition: trace RY becomes RY(.real actual), trace CX becomes CX. realize/plane/emitSteps preserve this constructor set. compileGray feeds actual soLog steps to emitSteps; compileAt uses that returned list. compileStages collect, padding, closed placement, ordered assembly and public rename preserve constructors. exact_compile_basis follows these definitions; compile_dyadic_basis then eliminates actual map membership and supplies the actual numerator witness. Matrix equality is not used to infer syntactic closure.
actual_return_audit.representation: For every actual returned RY, angle is exactly ExactAngle.rational((m:Rat)/(2:Rat)^bits), m=Int.floor(angle.eval*2^bits). Rat reduction may shorten the denominator, but its value is still that integer-over-power-of-two dyadic. Angles are radians under standardRyMatrix(angle.eval), not dyadic multiples of pi. The mathematical finite integer/rational value is genuine; no algorithm for obtaining m is supplied.
actual_return_audit.negative_rounding: floor is downward for negative as well as positive angles. 2^bits>0 and floor(x)<=x<floor(x)+1 give 0<=theta-m/2^bits<2^-bits, hence the proved weak absolute-error bound. No truncation-to-zero or float conversion is substituted. bits=0 remains valid.

semantic_audit.operator_provider: PrimitiveRyPerturbation proves lifted RY distance exactly 2*abs(sin((a.eval-b.eval)/4)) and at most abs(a.eval-b.eval)/2, retaining physical spectators and scalar sign. PrimitiveCircuitPerturbation telescopes positional GateAligned under eval(g::rest)=eval(rest)*eval(g), using actual unitary factors and induced Euclidean L2 norms.
semantic_audit.operator_bound: Internally produced alignment supplies delta=2^-bits. Actual exact-source list length <=48*N*D^3, N=n+1,D=2*k+6, yields norm(eval(returned)-eval(actual exact source)) <=24*N*D^3/2^bits. This comparison does not claim full-unitary equality to legacy Hermite preparation across possibly different completions.
semantic_audit.literal_target: target is a full EuclideanSpace vector indexed by every physical basis. Data occupy low wires, bond high wires. On Fin.append x b, coordinate is the literal signed normalizedAmplitude k (n+1) L at primitiveBasisLEEquiv(x) if b=0, and zero otherwise. exact_column_target decomposes every basis by castAdd/natAdd and uses the shared authored GlobalAssembly.compile_columns root.
semantic_audit.operator_to_state: column is action on computational zero. column_error uses its norm-one Euclidean single basis vector and Matrix.toEuclideanCLM, so full column difference is bounded by the induced operator norm. compile_state_error and compile_epsilon compare directly to the literal target, retaining every garbage coordinate; no postselection, projection, absolute amplitudes or global-phase quotient is present.
semantic_audit.rounded_garbage_boundary: The target and exact-source column have zero nonzero-bond coordinates. The rounded output is only close in the full vector norm; its garbage is controlled by the same epsilon budget, not asserted exactly zero. Relative signs and global phase are part of that norm comparison.

allocation_and_resources.bitsFor: Set A=24*N*D^3>0, M=max(1,Nat.ceil(A/epsilon)), b=Nat.clog 2 M. Nat.le_ceil and Nat.le_pow_clog imply A/epsilon<=M<=2^b; epsilon>0 gives A/2^b<=epsilon. For epsilon>=A, b=0 is legitimate. For epsilon<A, this is logarithmic fractional-grid allocation, not a numerator bit-length or finite preprocessing bound. The source regression A(0,0)=5184,epsilon=1,b=13 is arithmetically consistent.
allocation_and_resources.same_return: compile_certified let-binds one rounded list and combines its original-list length equality, exact Resource equality, <=48*N*D^3 gate/depth bounds, zero oracle calls, actual unitary evaluator and full-state epsilon error. compile_dyadic_basis separately applies to this identical compile return.
allocation_and_resources.resource_model: Resource equality follows identical one/two-qubit constructors and touched-wire sets, preserving the actual wireDepths fold and depth. Its fields are oneQubit,cnot,oracleCalls,pureAncilla,depth; physical qubit width is the type, not a Resource field. PrimitiveCircuit.resource sets pureAncilla and oracleCalls to zero by convention. This is not a proof that physical bond wires are absent, nor a finite-bit gate synthesis cost.
allocation_and_resources.not_classical_cost: The inherited source real-operation model is not the total cost of the new supplier. No round-map list allocation, floor work, bigint cost, saved-file work or hardware angle synthesis is charged by compile_certified. No resource optimization is asserted.

real_floor_boundary.proved_scope: For arbitrary real 0<a<1, numerator 0 (.real a)=0 and numerator 0 (.real(-a))=-1. Therefore a single interval [-a,a] of arbitrarily small width does not determine equality to the literal floor numerator.
real_floor_boundary.not_source_witness: This is a generic ExactAngle.real discriminator, not a witness that a particular Hermite-produced angle necessarily crosses a bin or makes finite precision fail.
real_floor_boundary.not_impossibility: A separation or endpoint strategy is needed to certify exact equality to this literal floor output from enclosures. That discontinuous equality requirement does not make approximate angle computation impossible. A computable nearby-grid supplier with certified slack can avoid exact-bin decisions under a versioned contract and recomposed error budget; no such implementation is proved here.

remaining_finite_bit_gaps: Finite encoding and input-error contract for arbitrary real L and epsilon are absent. ExactAngle.real and ExactAngle.eval are not finite input APIs.
No executable real-floor numerator supplier, certified enclosures, extraction or termination/running-time theorem; bitsFor also uses noncomputable real ceil for arbitrary real epsilon.
No source-to-angle numerical refinement for exp, sqrt, arccos, trigonometric or field operations through actual canonicalization, SO/Givens and local emission.

No robust finite precision treatment of comparisons, zero pivots, deficient ranks, determinant/sign choices, cancellation, small divisors or floor endpoints; source-input and QR/canonicalization perturbations are unbudgeted.

No bound or cost theorem for integer numerator magnitude, total signed integer bit length, Rat normalization, variable-word arithmetic, rounding-map traversal/allocation, enclosure precision, serialization or total finite-bit preprocessing.

No parser/serializer refinement binding saved bytes to this actual returned dyadic list, preserving radix/exponent/sign, radians, wire indices, gate order and count. Historical float/QASM transport diagnostics do not establish this.
No physical backend implementation or synthesis-cost certificate for exact dyadic-radian RY instructions; the declared mathematical RY/CX resource model remains separate.
No uniform finite-bit full-source-to-state theorem, numerical ROOT acceptance, scientific Hermite impossibility, publication admission or whole-chain independent validation.
